name: ribbon
description: A slim band above the prompt: how much of your 5-hour and 7-day usage is left, when each resets, and whether the prompt cache is warm or cold with what the next message costs.

showWeekly.title: Show weekly usage
showWeekly.description: Show the 7-day (7D) window in the band. Off: only the 5-hour window shows, which leaves more room on a narrow window.

showFiveHour.title: Show 5-hour usage
showFiveHour.description: Show the 5-hour (5H) window in the band. With this and Show weekly usage both off, the band shows only the prompt cache: warm or cold, the time left, and the next message's cost.

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: How large the band's text and badge are drawn in the desktop app, VS Code and mobile. The terminal has one text size and ignores this.
